Fueling Deicing

静電ボンド

Earthing connection between aircraft and fuelling equipment used to equalise electrical potential and prevent electrostatic discharge during refuelling.

Quick answer: Earthing connection between aircraft and fuelling equipment used to equalise electrical potential and prevent electrostatic discharge during refuelling.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 静電ボンド?

In this glossary, 静電ボンド refers to: Earthing connection between aircraft and fuelling equipment used to equalise electrical potential and prevent electrostatic discharge during refuelling.

How is 静電ボンド used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "ランプ管制: 24番スポットの航空機は、静電ボンドが接続され安全が確認されるまで給油を開始しないでください。"

Definition

Earthing connection between aircraft and fuelling equipment used to equalise electrical potential and prevent electrostatic discharge during refuelling.

Operational example

Ramp Control: Aircraft on Stand 24, do not start refuelling until the static bond is connected and confirmed secure.

Localized term

静電ボンド

Localized example

ランプ管制: 24番スポットの航空機は、静電ボンドが接続され安全が確認されるまで給油を開始しないでください。
